shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'next.config.*' -g 'app/**' -g 'src/**' -g 'pages/**' | head -200 && find node_modules/next/dist/docs -maxdepth 3 -type f | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "cat AGENTS.md && cat package.json && sed -n '1,240p' app/catalog/page.tsx && sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,200p' app/layout.tsx && rg -n \"prefetch|searchParams|loading\\.tsx|Instant Navigation|Link\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/instant-navigation.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/keeping-pages-static.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/adopting-partial-prefetching.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/04-api-reference/04-functions/use-search-params.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/04-api-reference/02-components/link.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files app lib && cat next.config.ts && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/instant-navigation.md && sed -n '460,585p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/adopting-partial-prefetching.md && rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app | rg 'optimizing-prefetching|api-reference/components/link|api-reference/directives/use-cache|route-segment-config/prefetch'"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- app/page.tsx app/catalog/page.tsx lib/data.ts && git status --short'
